theme: Light Theme (B2B SaaS style for clarity and accessibility)

typography.instructions: Use Manrope for headings with 'tracking-tight'. Use Figtree for body text with 'leading-relaxed'. Ensure clear hierarchy. Do not use Inter for headings.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft ambient shadows ('shadow-sm') for admin cards, and 'shadow-md' for hover states on reseller product cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0. Add 'rounded-xl' for product cards and 'rounded-lg' for dashboard widgets. Avoid sharp edges.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for the mobile sticky nav and top admin header: 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70' with a bottom border.

components.buttons: Rounded-md or pill-shaped. Primary buttons use the primary color with hover state ('hover:bg-blue-800'). Always explicitly set hover text color.
components.cards: Flat background with 1px subtle border. Hover states on interactive cards should have slight lift ('-translate-y-1') and 'shadow-lg'.
components.tables: Use TanStack Table for Admin DataTable. Ensure rows are expandable for mobile responsive views.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI inputs. Left-aligned text, clear focus states ('focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500').
components.badges: Use status colors for badges. Example: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700' for Menunggu Konfirmasi.

layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar navigation (hidden on mobile, accessible via hamburger). Grid layout for KPI cards ('grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4'). Chart section taking full width.
layouts.reseller_dashboard: Mobile-first. Product catalog grid ('grid-cols-2' on mobile, 'grid-cols-4' on desktop) with 8 items per page. Cart card-list stacked vertically.
layouts.spacing: Generous padding. Use 'p-4' or 'p-6' inside cards. 'gap-4' or 'gap-6' in grids. Ensure containers have internal padding to prevent text collision.

motion.transitions: Add smooth hover transitions for interactive elements ('transition-colors transition-transform duration-200').
motion.entrances: Staggered fade-up for product cards. Avoid relying purely on motion for information.

accessibility.instructions: Ensure contrast ratio for text over status backgrounds (APCA guidelines). Use 'data-testid' on all interactive elements. Add aria-labels to icon-only buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install libraries: react-router-dom, recharts, @tanstack/react-table, lucide-react, sonner, date-fns.
Format currency using Rp prefix and dot separators (e.g., Rp1.250.000).
Format dates strictly as DD-MM-YYYY HH:mm.
Implement language entirely in Bahasa Indonesia. Use terms like 'Menunggu Konfirmasi', 'Diproses', 'Selesai', 'Belum Lunas', 'Lunas', 'Error'.
Ensure a mobile-first design for Reseller views (responsive product cards, tap-friendly cart card lists, responsive navbar).
Create a clean Admin Dashboard with KPI cards and Recharts for orders.
Use TanStack Table for orders list with expandable rows for responsive display.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, menus, error messages, and interactive cards.
For receipt photo uploads, implement a clean UI (custom item mapping).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and floating elements.
DO NOT apply universal transition ('transition: all'). Use specific transitions ('transition-colors', 'transition-transform').
DO NOT center align the app container. Respect natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (rounded-md or pill) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons. Use Lucide React.
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover states, subtle active scales.
Ensure generous spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, overlays, or navs.
